confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Iceland's high price level, calibrated to the supplied Vienna, Berlin and Bucharest figures; no live Reykjavik prices, menus or listings were checked. Food and drink anchors are the more reliable group (roughly +/-25%). July peak-season accommodation, especially private hostel rooms and 3-star hotels, is least certain (+/-30% or more). Cocktail and wine_glass use a beer-relative basis (cocktail about 1.7x beer, wine about 1.4x beer) because direct local knowledge is weaker. FX (RBA 2026-10-14, 0.7002, latest found) came from a search summary of the RBA homepage exchange-rate panel and was not confirmed against the F11.1 table; re-check before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city fits. Reykjavik is calibrated upward from the supplied Vienna and Berlin figures as a high-cost Nordic capital: cafe and restaurant anchors about 1.4-1.7x, beer about 2-2.2x, hotel anchors about 1.8-2x, and hostel beds about 2.4-2.8x. Bucharest serves only as a floor sense check.
